note: This repository's inventory, produced by scripts/secret_inventory.py over the working tree and all reachable history. Every disposition covers ONE exact line by digest, not a path and not a pattern: change the line and the disposition stops matching, so a real credential can never inherit a fixture's exemption. The posture below is ADVISORY and the dispositions gate nothing until a human declares enforcing (D4), which is why an agent may write them. This file should sit under protected_paths before that flip. The reasons below DESCRIBE each fixture and never quote it: a disposition record that reproduced what it found would be exactly the second copy this design exists to avoid.

declaration.reason: Dmitry approved the flip on 2026-08-03 10:24 EDT with the inventory in hand: he was told the tree and all reachable history are clean, that every one of the ~900 pattern findings is one of 22 conformance-fixture lines, and that zero real credentials exist. D4 sequenced advisory first per repository; that condition is met, so this repository is now fail-closed. Going back to advisory needs a written reason, by design.

measured.note: THE BASE RATE, which is why entropy is advisory and pattern gates: roughly 20 entropy hits for every pattern hit over a whole-history sweep. Entropy is a proportionate diff-time tripwire where the unit is a handful of changed lines; as an inventory gate at this ratio it guarantees somebody turns the gate off. These counts are a DATED SNAPSHOT and drift with every commit - re-run scripts/secret_inventory.py for the current figures. What must stay true is that outstanding is zero, which the gate checks rather than trusting these numbers.
